steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: The Desk page is where operators monitor the Hypothesis Foundry state. We'll start by navigating there.
steps.point_out: The page loads with several sections, including the Hypothesis Foundry panel at the bottom.

steps.title: Expand the Hypothesis Foundry section
steps.narration: The Hypothesis Foundry panel starts collapsed. We click the section header to expand it and see all subsections.
steps.point_out: The panel expands to reveal six subsections: Sources / Compiler, Interpreter Fixtures, Freeze / Integrity, Hermetic Oracles, Epoch / Manifest, and the new Runner / Checkpoint.

steps.title: Expand the Epoch / Manifest subsection
steps.narration: We click Epoch / Manifest to confirm the sibling subsection still works as before—this regression check proves nothing broke.
steps.point_out: The Epoch / Manifest subsection shows the frozen epoch ID and the 'Real Epoch — not a fixture' green banner.

steps.title: Expand the new Runner / Checkpoint subsection
steps.narration: This is the new subsection for this iteration. It shows the real exhaust pass state after running the Foundry CLI.
steps.point_out: The subsection expands to show the checkpoint details, including the first-read lock timestamp, the manifest hash, and the exhaust completion status.

steps.title: Verify the first-read lock timestamp
steps.narration: The first-read lock marks the moment when the exhaust pass definitively evaluated the frozen epoch. This timestamp proves the lock was recorded.
steps.point_out: The 'First-read lock recorded at:' line shows the exact UTC timestamp (2026-08-27T06:55:51.071173Z), confirming the exhaust run completed.

steps.title: Check the checkpoint count and protected-read census
steps.narration: The checkpoint line shows how many candidates reached a final state. The protected-read count, displayed in green, proves no off-limits data was touched.
steps.point_out: The 'Checkpoint: 0 of 0' and 'Protected/withheld/sealed reads: 0' lines confirm the honest, zero-candidate result for this frozen epoch.

steps.title: View the completion message and freeze integrity status
steps.narration: The bottom of the subsection shows the exhaust-complete verdict and the freeze integrity verdict. For this epoch, completion is honest and vacuous—zero candidates ever existed.
steps.point_out: The 'Exhaust complete' message plainly states the result: 'zero FROZEN_READY variants this epoch — an honest, vacuous completion.' The 'Freeze integrity: green' line confirms all integrity checks passed.

steps.title: Verify sibling subsections remain unchanged
steps.narration: We check the Sources / Compiler subsection to confirm no other subsections were accidentally modified. This regression test ensures the change was purely additive.
steps.point_out: The Sources / Compiler subsection still displays 'Hashes match — outcome-blind compilation proven.' exactly as before.
